generic_lessons: A durable reservation and a fresh send grant are different. A loaded ARMED record cannot authorize a new command; uncertain records must survive later turns while still allowing late effect observation.
Pre-send persistence protects against replay but has availability cost: a verified intent followed by a final qualification failure can remain unsent and held. Do not erase that history by timeout.
Realm-specific native ports matter. UI Map.GetCityPlots is absent in Core; primary Cities.GetPlotPurchaseCity provides full purchase-city identity there.

A passing full test run may double collect imported TestCase methods. Record the actual collected result and separate the import correction plus targeted pass, rather than inventing a clean full rerun.
Equal selected WORLD/CITY/building/district/plot/unit samples do not prove whole-world equality. A different city food and production yield across cold load must remain an unisolated delta.

Original UI close callbacks may issue mark-seen operations. Count human confirmations separately from background diplomacy and do not report zero all game operations when low-level counts were not observed.
